lesson.text: Quick memory: what does the top number of a time signature tell you? (How many beats are in each bar.) Today: reading notes on the stave.
Notes are written on a stave: 5 lines and the 4 spaces between them. The higher a note sits on the stave, the higher it sounds.
The treble clef at the start curls round the second line from the bottom. That line is G, so the treble clef is also called the G clef.
The notes on the lines, from the bottom, are E, G, B, D, F: Every Good Boy Deserves Football.
The notes in the spaces, from the bottom, spell FACE: F, A, C, E.
Middle C sits on its own short line below the stave, called a ledger line. D sits just under the bottom line.
From middle C up to the next C: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C, 8 notes, an octave. Note names use only the letters A to G, then start again.
Try it in the world: build a giant stave on the ground in your world: 5 rows of blocks with gaps between. Stand on a line or in a space, and ask a friend to name your note.

exercises.prompt: Which note is this?
exercises.hint: Is it on a line or in a space? Lines from the bottom: E, G, B, D, F. Spaces: F, A, C, E.
exercises.explain: It is on line 2 from the bottom: G.

exercises.prompt: Which note is this?
exercises.hint: Is it on a line or in a space? Lines from the bottom: E, G, B, D, F. Spaces: F, A, C, E.
exercises.explain: It is on the bottom line: E.

exercises.prompt: How many lines does a stave have?
exercises.hint: Count the long lines in any stave picture.
exercises.explain: A stave has 5 lines (and 4 spaces between them).

exercises.prompt: The spaces of the treble stave spell FACE, from the bottom up.
exercises.hint: Name the spaces from the bottom.
exercises.explain: True: F, A, C, E.

exercises.prompt: Listen. Which stave shows the tune you hear?
exercises.hint: Does each note go up or down? By a step or a jump?
exercises.explain: The tune climbs step by step: C, D, E, F.

exercises.prompt: Which note is this?
exercises.hint: Look below the stave: is it on its own short line?
exercises.explain: It sits on the short ledger line below the stave: middle C.

exercises.prompt: Which note is this?
exercises.hint: Is it on a line or in a space? Lines from the bottom: E, G, B, D, F. Spaces: F, A, C, E.
exercises.explain: It is on the middle line, line 3: B.

exercises.prompt: Name each note. Which word do they spell?
exercises.hint: Name the notes one at a time, left to right.
exercises.explain: B (the middle line), A (space 2), G (line 2): BAG.

exercises.prompt: Match each one to its place on the stave.
exercises.hint: Remember Every Good Boy Deserves Football, and FACE.
exercises.explain: Lines: E G B D F. Spaces: F A C E. Middle C: a ledger line. The treble clef curls round G.

exercises.prompt: Listen. Which stave shows the tune you hear?
exercises.hint: Does each note go up or down? By a step or a jump?
exercises.explain: The tune walks down step by step: G, F, E, D.

exercises.prompt: Listen: middle C, then the C above it. Which stave shows them?
exercises.hint: Is the second note higher or lower? How far?
exercises.explain: Middle C sits below the stave; the C above it is in the third space: 8 notes higher.

exercises.prompt: Listen. The tune goes C, D, E. Which note comes next?
exercises.hint: Each note is one step up from the one before. Which letter comes after E?
exercises.explain: It climbs step by step: C, D, E, F.

exercises.prompt: Name each note. Which word do they spell?
exercises.hint: Name the notes one at a time, left to right.
exercises.explain: C (space 3), A (space 2), G (line 2), E (the bottom line): CAGE.

exercises.prompt: Name each note. Which word do they spell?
exercises.hint: Name the notes one at a time, left to right.
exercises.explain: F, A, C, E: every space from the bottom. It spells FACE.

exercises.prompt: Put these notes in order, lowest first.
exercises.hint: Lower on the stave is lower in sound.
exercises.explain: Middle C is below the stave, then E on the bottom line, A in the second space, and F on the top line.

exercises.prompt: Listen: a tune climbs from middle C, step by step. Which is its third note?
exercises.hint: Count up the letters from C: first, second, third.
exercises.explain: C, D, E: the third note is E.

exercises.prompt: Listen. Which stave shows the tune you hear?
exercises.hint: Does the tune go up or down?
exercises.explain: It climbs from G, step by step: G, A, B, C.

exercises.prompt: A note on a line sounds higher than a note in the space just above it.
exercises.hint: Higher on the stave means higher in sound.
exercises.explain: False: the space above is higher on the stave, so it sounds higher.

exercises.prompt: From middle C up to the next C, how many notes are there, counting both Cs?
exercises.hint: Say the letter names from middle C up to the next C, and count them.
exercises.explain: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: 8 notes, an octave.

exercises.prompt: Put the notes on the stave's lines in order, from the bottom line up.
exercises.hint: Every Good Boy Deserves Football.
exercises.explain: From the bottom line up: E, G, B, D, F. Every Good Boy Deserves Football.

exercises.prompt: A tune starts on middle C and climbs step by step for 5 notes. How many of the 5 notes sit on the stave's 5 lines?
exercises.hint: Name the 5 notes, then check each one: a stave line, a space, or below the stave?
exercises.explain: C, D, E, F, G. Middle C is on a ledger line and D sits just below the stave. E and G are on lines and F is in a space: 2 notes on the stave's lines.

exercises.prompt: Match each place on the treble stave, from the bottom, to its note.
exercises.hint: Lines E G B D F and spaces F A C E, both from the bottom: they take turns going up.
exercises.explain: Going up the stave, lines and spaces take turns: E (the bottom line), F (the first space), G (the second line), A (the second space). The letters climb in order.
